svg.title: Presentation board for the preloved thrift admin panel designed in Figma: dashboard with items received and sold, a clothing review that sends each item to sale or recycling, the catalogue, and the wired prototype. Demo data.
svg.text: Review donated clothes, send them to sale or recycling, verify buyers, sellers and recycle staff
01 Dashboard: items received vs sold, accounts by role
03 Catalogue of items ready to sell
04 Prototype: flows wired across review, catalogue, recycling and accounts
Figma · admin dashboard, 3 key screens and the prototype. Demo data.
